== chapter 115 ==

## The previous part ends

- t: ወካዕበ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ሐመ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ በግብጽ ፡ ጸውዖሙ ፡ ለአኀዊሁ ፡ ወለደቂቁ ፡ ወአምሐሎሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይኅድጉ ፡ አዕፅምቲሁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፤ አላ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ሐወጸክሙ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ንሥኡ ፡ ምስሌክሙ ፡ ወደምሩ ፡ አዕፅምትየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መቃብረ ፡ አበዊየ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
- i: And again, when Joseph fell ill in Egypt, he called his brothers and his sons and made them swear that they would not leave his bones in the land of Egypt, but that, 'When God visits you, take them with you, and gather up my bones into the tomb of my fathers.'

Words in this part: 546.
